annotations.title: Official Dutch tax figures with their sources

description: Looks up official Dutch tax figures for 2024, 2025 or 2026 with the source of each: tax brackets and rates, tax credits, Box 3 allowance and returns, the own home (eigenwoningforfait), the 30% ruling norm and cap, self-employed deductions, and for 2026 also allowances, NHG, the BV, visa salary norms, gift and inheritance tax, company cars and health insurance.

query.description: Words to search for, in English or Dutch, e.g. "box 3 allowance", "arbeidskorting", "zelfstandigenaftrek". Empty lists the groups.
